note_on_split: Training (dataset/) and test (test_dataset/) are separate folders. The 80/20 train/val split is computed within the dataset/ folder during training. No images from test_dataset/ were used during training or validation.
imbalance_note: Fowl Pox is significantly underrepresented (127 train, 28 test) compared to Coccidiosis, Healthy, and Salmonella (450 each). Balanced class weights were applied during training via compute_class_weight('balanced').
limitations: No metadata about farm, bird ID, or video sequence origin — near-duplicate images from the same bird cannot be detected by SHA-256 alone.
Class imbalance in Fowl Pox (127 train vs 450 others) may affect recall; class weighting was applied during training.
Dataset source, geographic origin, camera hardware, and licensing are not documented in the project — these must be disclosed in the IEEE paper.
Generalization to different farms, breeds, or camera conditions has not been evaluated.
